definition.note: Genus-4 (per cell) member of Schoen's 1970 NASA report, in a 1-parameter family; one nodal limit is two planes joined per cell by one large and four small catenoidal necks, the other limit is 8-ended singly periodic Scherk surfaces.  The name derives from the two skeletal graphs of the complement: square grids at different sizes.
